# GMEOW Calendar and Scheduling Module

The GMEOW Calendar and Scheduling Module — classes, properties, and individuals of the GMEOW super-vocabulary.

**IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/slices/calendar>  
**CURIE:** `gmeow:slices/calendar`  

**Type:** `owl:Ontology`  

The calendar and scheduling slice: recurrence, availability, RSVP, reminders, tasks, and time zones on top of events. Builds on the events module (#41) and temporal module, reusing Event, Participation, EventSeries/RecurrenceRule, TimeInterval, and the four clocks. Aligns to iCalendar RFC 5545/5546/6047/4791/6638/7809, jCal RFC 7265, xCal RFC 6321, schema.org Schedule/EventSeries, OWL-Time, and Wikidata by reference.

DESIGN PRINCIPLES.
  * Schedule ≠ occurrence: an EventSchedule (rule + anchor + time zone) GENERATES Event occurrences; it is not itself the occurrence (Principle 1).
  * Reify social acts as relators: EventInvitation and Availability use the Participation idiom — never flat properties.
  * Open value vocabularies, not subclasses: invitationStatus, rsvpStatus, availabilityStatus, reminderAction, taskStatus, exceptionType are individuals, never Event/Task subclasses (Principle 9).
  * Cancelled ≠ deleted (Principle 10): a cancelled/rescheduled occurrence is displayable false + a ScheduleException, retained, never erased.
  * Contested times coexist (#43): disputed times are standpoint-indexed via accordingTo; no single winner.
  * DL-clean time: datetimes are xsd:dateTime, durations xsd:duration; recurrence as a literal rule (RFC 5545 text) + structured form, kept out of OWL cardinality.

**Defined by:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/slices/calendar>
